## How the ROSE-REC2 Fits the Workflow

The ROSE-REC2 is a **pure USB mass storage device** — no app, no Wi-Fi, no cloud. It stores recordings as MP3 files directly on its 136GB internal memory. Since it has no automatic sync, the handoff step is manual but takes seconds:

**Step 1 — Plug in the ROSE-REC2 via USB-C.** It mounts as a USB drive on your Mac or PC.

**Step 2 — Copy new MP3 files into the Notion Inbox.** Either attach them directly as Notion file blocks, or drop them into whatever local folder you use to stage files before sending them to me.

**Step 3 — Tell me to run the inbox check.** From that point, the workflow is identical to iCloud: I transcribe each file with full dialogue and timestamps, create a named summary document, classify it (Meetings, Calls, Personal Notes, Marc's Inappropriate Screaming, or Other), and move both the audio and the summary to the correct folder.

---

The vault now officially supports both sources under the same system. Next time you plug in the ROSE-REC2 and have new recordings to process, just drop the files in the Inbox and run the check.
